meta.name: general-video
meta.description: Author or edit a custom HyperFrames composition when no specialized workflow fits, or when BRIEF.md sets flow: companion. Use for longer or multi-scene pieces, brand and sizzle reels, montages, static loops, static title cards, footage remixes, and freeform builds. Use motion-graphics instead for a short unnarrated motion-first unit, including an animated title. Route fresh creation through hyperframes before using this skill.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 剪辑出品牌片、蒙太奇、片头等各类自定义视频作品。
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要灵活创作非模板化的自定义视频内容。
copy.tagline_en: Produce and edit custom video pieces, from brand reels to montages.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need a flexible video creation tool for original, non-templated content.

howto.what: 当没有专门工作流匹配时，Claude 会按此技能创建或编辑视频合成：先更新技能，再依项目状态读取 BRIEF.md、处理媒体资源、规划多场景、生成故事板，遵循 HyperFrames 规则执行。
howto.when: 触发条件：没有专门工作流匹配，或 BRIEF.md 设置了 flow: companion。适用于较长或多场景视频、品牌片、素材混剪等。

howto.what_en: When no specialized workflow fits, Claude uses this skill to create or edit video compositions: it first updates the skill, then reads project state and BRIEF.md, handles media assets, plans multi-scene layouts, generates storyboards, and follows HyperFrames rules.
howto.when_en: Triggers when no specialized workflow fits, or when BRIEF.md sets flow: companion. Ideal for longer or multi-scene pieces, brand reels, montages, footage remixes, etc.
